apple__scab.name: Apple scab
apple__scab.symptoms: Olive-green to black velvety spots on leaves and fruit, leaves twist and drop, fruit cracks.
act_now: Spray a protectant (captan or mancozeb) before the next rain; add a systemic (difenoconazole) if lesions are already visible.
Rake and destroy fallen leaves; they carry next year's inoculum.
apple__scab.organic: Sulphur or copper at green tip, repeated every 7-10 days in wet spring weather.
apple__scab.chemical: Captan 2 g/L or mancozeb 2.5 g/L protectant; difenoconazole 0.5 ml/L or myclobutanil curative within 72 h of infection.
apple__scab.prevent: Resistant varieties, urea spray on leaf litter in autumn, open canopy pruning.

apple__black_rot.name: Black rot
apple__black_rot.symptoms: Purple-bordered 'frog-eye' leaf spots, rotting fruit with concentric rings, cankers on limbs.
act_now: Prune out cankered limbs and mummified fruit.
Apply captan or thiophanate-methyl from petal fall.
apple__black_rot.prevent: Remove dead wood and fruit mummies, avoid tree stress.

apple__cedar_apple_rust.name: Cedar-apple rust
apple__cedar_apple_rust.symptoms: Bright orange-yellow spots on upper leaf surface with tube-like structures beneath; needs junipers nearby.
act_now: Spray myclobutanil or mancozeb from pink bud through second cover.
Remove nearby junipers' orange galls where practical.
apple__cedar_apple_rust.organic: Sulphur sprays during spore release in spring.

apple__healthy.name: Healthy
apple__healthy.symptoms: Uniform green leaves without spots or rust pustules.
act_now: Keep protectant cover in wet springs; scab starts before you see it.
apple__healthy.prevent: Prune for airflow, balanced nitrogen, leaf litter management.

cherry__powdery_mildew.name: Powdery mildew
cherry__powdery_mildew.symptoms: White powdery patches on young leaves and shoots; leaves curl and blister.
act_now: Spray sulphur or a DMI fungicide at first white patch.
Thin dense shoots to reduce humidity.
cherry__powdery_mildew.prevent: Open canopy, avoid excess nitrogen, remove water sprouts.

cherry__healthy.name: Healthy
cherry__healthy.symptoms: Glossy green leaves, no powder or spots.
act_now: Scout new shoots weekly after harvest for mildew.

citrus__greening.name: Citrus greening (HLB)
citrus__greening.symptoms: Blotchy asymmetric leaf mottling, yellow shoots, small lopsided bitter fruit; tree declines over years.
act_now: There is no cure: remove and destroy confirmed trees to protect the block.
Control Asian citrus psyllid on remaining trees with imidacloprid soil drench or thiamethoxam.
citrus__greening.organic: Neem oil and kaolin clay against psyllid; remove infected trees.
citrus__greening.chemical: Imidacloprid drench 0.5 ml/L, dimethoate spray at flush; rotate.
citrus__greening.prevent: Certified disease-free nursery stock, psyllid monitoring with yellow traps, area-wide control.

citrus__canker.name: Citrus canker
citrus__canker.symptoms: Raised corky brown lesions with yellow halos on leaves, twigs and fruit; premature leaf and fruit drop.
act_now: Copper spray at each flush and after storms.
Prune out heavily cankered twigs; disinfect tools with 1% bleach.
citrus__canker.organic: Copper hydroxide 2 g/L every 3 weeks during flush.
citrus__canker.chemical: Copper oxychloride 3 g/L plus streptomycin 0.1 g/L in outbreaks.
citrus__canker.prevent: Windbreaks, leaf-miner control (it opens wounds), avoid overhead irrigation.

citrus__black_spot.name: Citrus black spot
citrus__black_spot.symptoms: Small sunken black spots with grey centres on fruit; leaf spots with dark margins.
act_now: Protectant sprays (mancozeb, copper) from fruit set for 4-5 months.
Remove leaf litter under trees.
citrus__black_spot.organic: Copper hydroxide monthly through the susceptible period.
citrus__black_spot.prevent: Leaf litter mulching or removal, balanced nutrition.

citrus__healthy.name: Healthy
citrus__healthy.symptoms: Symmetrical green leaves, no mottling or lesions.
act_now: Check new flush for psyllids and leaf miner every week.
citrus__healthy.prevent: Psyllid control, certified stock, balanced micronutrients.

corn__gray_leaf_spot.name: Gray leaf spot
corn__gray_leaf_spot.symptoms: Rectangular grey-tan lesions running parallel to veins, starting on lower leaves; can blight the whole plant before grain fill.
act_now: If lesions reach the third leaf below the ear before tasseling, spray a strobilurin plus triazole.
Note fields with residue; rotate next season.
corn__gray_leaf_spot.organic: No effective organic curative; resistant hybrids and residue management.
corn__gray_leaf_spot.chemical: Azoxystrobin + propiconazole at VT-R1; pyraclostrobin + metconazole.
corn__gray_leaf_spot.prevent: Rotate away from corn, bury residue, resistant hybrids.

corn__common_rust.name: Common rust
corn__common_rust.symptoms: Small brick-red pustules on both leaf surfaces, later turning black.
act_now: Sweet corn or seed corn: spray at first pustules. Field corn usually needs no spray unless severe before tasseling.
corn__common_rust.organic: Sulphur dust in sweet corn; resistant hybrids.

corn__northern_leaf_blight.name: Northern leaf blight
corn__northern_leaf_blight.symptoms: Long cigar-shaped grey-green to tan lesions 3-15 cm on leaves, starting low and moving up.
act_now: Spray strobilurin + triazole if lesions are on the ear leaf or above before R3.
Scout every 3 days during silking.

corn__healthy.name: Healthy
corn__healthy.symptoms: Green leaves free of lesions and pustules.
act_now: Scout lower leaves weekly from V8 to R3, especially in corn-on-corn.

cotton__bacterial_blight.name: Bacterial blight (angular leaf spot)
cotton__bacterial_blight.symptoms: Angular water-soaked leaf spots bounded by veins, black vein streaks, boll rot.
act_now: Copper oxychloride plus streptocycline spray; repeat after 10 days.
Avoid overhead irrigation and field work while foliage is wet.
cotton__bacterial_blight.prevent: Resistant varieties, acid-delinted seed, 2-year rotation, residue destruction.

cotton__leaf_curl_virus.name: Cotton leaf curl virus
cotton__leaf_curl_virus.symptoms: Upward or downward leaf curling, thickened veins, leaf-like enations on the underside, stunting.
act_now: Uproot early-infected plants.
Control whitefly: yellow sticky traps, neem oil, then diafenthiuron or spiromesifen at threshold.
cotton__leaf_curl_virus.organic: Neem oil 5 ml/L weekly, yellow traps at 20/acre.
cotton__leaf_curl_virus.chemical: Diafenthiuron 1 g/L, spiromesifen 1 ml/L, flonicamid; rotate.
cotton__leaf_curl_virus.prevent: Tolerant varieties, early sowing, avoid excess nitrogen, remove weed hosts.

cotton__fusarium_wilt.name: Fusarium wilt
cotton__fusarium_wilt.pathogen: Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. vasinfectum (fungus, soil-borne)
cotton__fusarium_wilt.symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of lower leaves, brown discolouration inside the stem, plant death in patches.
act_now: No cure for infected plants; remove them and note the patch.
Drench surrounding plants with carbendazim; add Trichoderma to soil.
cotton__fusarium_wilt.organic: Trichoderma viride 5 kg/ha with farmyard manure; neem cake.
cotton__fusarium_wilt.prevent: Resistant varieties, nematode control, long rotation with cereals.

cotton__healthy.name: Healthy
cotton__healthy.symptoms: Flat green leaves without curling, spots or wilting.
act_now: Count whiteflies on 3 leaves per plant twice a week.
cotton__healthy.prevent: Sticky traps, timely sowing, balanced nutrition.

grape__black_rot.name: Black rot
grape__black_rot.symptoms: Tan leaf spots with dark borders and black dots; berries shrivel into hard black mummies.
act_now: Spray mancozeb or myclobutanil from bud break through 4 weeks after bloom.
Remove mummified berries from vines and ground.
grape__black_rot.organic: Copper or sulphur early; strict sanitation.
grape__black_rot.prevent: Sanitation, canopy management, timely sprays around bloom.

grape__esca.name: Esca (black measles)
grape__esca.symptoms: Tiger-stripe yellow or red bands between veins, dark spots on berries, sudden vine collapse in hot weather.
act_now: No spray cures it. Mark affected vines; prune out dead wood in dry weather and protect pruning wounds.
Consider trunk renewal from a healthy sucker.
grape__esca.organic: Wound protection with Trichoderma paste after pruning.
grape__esca.chemical: Wound paint with boscalid/pyraclostrobin; no curative treatment.
grape__esca.prevent: Prune late in dormancy on dry days, seal large cuts, avoid water stress.

grape__leaf_blight.name: Isariopsis leaf blight
grape__leaf_blight.symptoms: Irregular dark brown patches on leaves with a felty underside; leaves drop early.
act_now: Spray mancozeb or copper; remove fallen leaves.

grape__healthy.name: Healthy
grape__healthy.symptoms: Green leaves, no spots, stripes or powder.
act_now: Keep the bloom-to-bunch-closure spray window covered in wet years.

peach__bacterial_spot.name: Bacterial spot
peach__bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small angular purple-black spots that drop out leaving shot holes; pitted fruit.
act_now: Copper at low rates at petal fall and shuck split; oxytetracycline in season.
Avoid wetting foliage.

peach__healthy.name: Healthy
peach__healthy.symptoms: Green leaves without shot-holes or spots.
act_now: Check for leaf curl at bud swell next spring.

strawberry__leaf_scorch.name: Leaf scorch
strawberry__leaf_scorch.symptoms: Many small purple spots that merge and scorch the leaf; edges curl and dry.
act_now: Remove old infected leaves after harvest; spray captan or myclobutanil.

strawberry__healthy.name: Healthy
act_now: Watch for mites and powdery mildew in warm dry spells.

pepper__bacterial_spot.name: Bacterial spot
pepper__bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small water-soaked spots on leaves that turn brown with yellow halos; raised scabby spots on fruit; heavy leaf drop.
act_now: Remove and destroy heavily spotted leaves and fruit; do not compost.
Stop overhead irrigation and avoid working in wet foliage.
Spray copper hydroxide plus mancozeb at 7-day intervals while weather stays wet.
pepper__bacterial_spot.organic: Copper-based bactericide; Bacillus subtilis biofungicide as protectant.
pepper__bacterial_spot.chemical: Copper hydroxide 2 g/L + mancozeb 2 g/L; streptomycin sulphate 0.5 g/L only in early outbreak.
pepper__bacterial_spot.prevent: Certified disease-free seed, hot-water seed treatment at 50 C for 25 min, 2-year rotation away from solanaceous crops.

pepper__healthy.name: Healthy
pepper__healthy.symptoms: No lesions, uniform green colour, normal leaf shape.
act_now: Keep scouting every 4-5 days, especially the lower canopy.
Maintain even irrigation and calcium supply to prevent blossom end rot.
pepper__healthy.prevent: Balanced fertigation, mulch, yellow sticky traps for early thrips and whitefly detection.

potato__early_blight.name: Early blight
potato__early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings (target pattern) on older lower leaves, yellowing around spots, premature defoliation.
act_now: Remove the worst affected lower leaves to reduce spore load.
Apply a protectant fungicide before the next rain or heavy dew.
Top-dress nitrogen if the crop is pale; early blight hits under-fed plants hardest.
potato__early_blight.organic: Copper oxychloride 3 g/L; Trichoderma viride soil application.
potato__early_blight.chemical: Mancozeb 2.5 g/L or chlorothalonil 2 g/L every 7-10 days; azoxystrobin 1 ml/L for curative action.
potato__early_blight.prevent: Rotate away from potato and tomato for 2 years, use certified seed, avoid overhead irrigation late in the day.

potato__late_blight.name: Late blight
potato__late_blight.symptoms: Large irregular greasy dark lesions on leaves and stems with white mould on the underside in humid mornings; whole field can collapse within a week.
act_now: Spray a systemic + contact mix today: cymoxanil + mancozeb or dimethomorph + mancozeb.
Destroy infected haulms; do not leave cull piles near the field.
Stop irrigation until foliage dries; earth up to protect tubers from spores.
potato__late_blight.organic: Copper hydroxide 2 g/L every 5 days in wet weather (protectant only).
potato__late_blight.chemical: Cymoxanil 8% + mancozeb 64% at 3 g/L; or mandipropamid 0.8 ml/L; alternate groups to avoid resistance.
potato__late_blight.prevent: Protectant sprays whenever the forecast shows 2+ days above 85% humidity and 10-24 C, resistant varieties, certified seed.

potato__healthy.name: Healthy
potato__healthy.symptoms: Uniform green foliage without lesions or curling.
act_now: Check the forecast: if 3 or more cool cloudy days are coming, apply a protectant before late blight can start.
potato__healthy.prevent: Earth up on time, keep ridges moist during tuber initiation, scout for late blight weekly in cool weather.

tomato__target_spot.name: Target spot
tomato__target_spot.symptoms: Brown lesions with concentric rings on leaves and fruit, often starting mid-canopy; pits on fruit.
act_now: Prune to open the canopy and improve air movement.
Apply chlorothalonil or azoxystrobin at first sign.
tomato__target_spot.chemical: Chlorothalonil 2 g/L; azoxystrobin 1 ml/L; alternate with mancozeb.
tomato__target_spot.prevent: Stake and prune, drip irrigation, remove crop debris after harvest.

tomato__mosaic_virus.name: Tomato mosaic virus
tomato__mosaic_virus.symptoms: Light and dark green mottling, fern-like distorted leaves, stunted plants, internal browning of fruit.
act_now: Rogue out infected plants immediately in a bag; wash hands and tools with 10% skim milk or soap.
There is no cure: focus on stopping spread by handling healthy plants first.
tomato__mosaic_virus.organic: None curative. Skim milk spray before handling reduces transmission.
tomato__mosaic_virus.chemical: None. Viruses do not respond to fungicides or insecticides.
tomato__mosaic_virus.prevent: Resistant varieties (Tm-2 gene), disinfect stakes and tools, no tobacco use near the crop, seed treatment with 10% trisodium phosphate.

tomato__yellow_leaf_curl_virus.name: Yellow leaf curl virus
tomato__yellow_leaf_curl_virus.symptoms: Upward curling and yellowing of leaf margins, small leaves, severe stunting, flower drop. Spread by whitefly.
act_now: Uproot and bag infected plants before whiteflies move on.
Put out yellow sticky traps at 20 per acre and spray neem oil 5 ml/L on leaf undersides.
If whitefly count exceeds 5 per leaf, apply spiromesifen or diafenthiuron.
tomato__yellow_leaf_curl_virus.organic: Neem oil weekly, reflective silver mulch, yellow sticky traps.
tomato__yellow_leaf_curl_virus.chemical: Diafenthiuron 1 g/L or spiromesifen 1 ml/L for whitefly; rotate modes of action.
tomato__yellow_leaf_curl_virus.prevent: Nursery under 40-mesh net, TYLCV-resistant hybrids, barrier crop of maize, avoid planting next to old infected fields.

tomato__bacterial_spot.name: Bacterial spot
tomato__bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small dark greasy spots with yellow halos on leaves; raised scabby spots on green fruit.
act_now: Remove spotted leaves; avoid touching wet plants.
Copper + mancozeb spray at 7-day intervals during wet spells.
tomato__bacterial_spot.chemical: Copper hydroxide 2 g/L + mancozeb 2 g/L; streptomycin only early.
tomato__bacterial_spot.prevent: Hot-water seed treatment, 2-year rotation, drip irrigation.

tomato__early_blight.name: Early blight
tomato__early_blight.symptoms: Target-pattern brown spots on older leaves, yellowing, defoliation from the bottom up; stem cankers and sunken fruit spots near the stem.
act_now: Strip the lowest infected leaves and remove from field.
Protectant fungicide before the next wet period.
Feed the crop: nitrogen and potash deficiency accelerate early blight.
tomato__early_blight.organic: Copper oxychloride 3 g/L; Trichoderma soil drench.
tomato__early_blight.chemical: Mancozeb 2.5 g/L or chlorothalonil 2 g/L every 7-10 days; azoxystrobin curative.
tomato__early_blight.prevent: Mulch to stop soil splash, stake plants, rotate crops, drip irrigation.

tomato__healthy.name: Healthy
tomato__healthy.symptoms: Uniform green colour, no spots, curling or mottling.
act_now: Scout undersides of leaves twice a week for whitefly and mites.
Keep watering even to prevent cracking and blossom end rot.
tomato__healthy.prevent: Sticky traps, mulch, calcium sprays at fruit set, balanced potash.

tomato__late_blight.name: Late blight
tomato__late_blight.symptoms: Large water-soaked grey-green lesions turning brown, white fuzzy growth on undersides in humid mornings, firm brown rot on fruit; spreads field-wide in days.
act_now: Spray a systemic + contact fungicide today (cymoxanil + mancozeb or dimethomorph + mancozeb).
Remove and bury infected plants; do not compost.
Suspend overhead irrigation.
tomato__late_blight.organic: Copper hydroxide every 5 days as a protectant while wet weather persists.
tomato__late_blight.chemical: Cymoxanil + mancozeb 3 g/L; mandipropamid 0.8 ml/L; alternate chemistry.
tomato__late_blight.prevent: Protectant sprays when forecast humidity stays above 85% with 10-24 C, wide spacing, resistant hybrids.

tomato__leaf_mold.name: Leaf mould
tomato__leaf_mold.symptoms: Pale yellow patches on upper leaf surface with olive-green velvety mould underneath; common in polyhouses and dense canopies.
act_now: Ventilate: prune lower leaves and widen spacing to drop humidity below 85%.
Apply chlorothalonil or copper.
tomato__leaf_mold.prevent: Resistant varieties, morning irrigation only, remove crop debris.

tomato__septoria_leaf_spot.name: Septoria leaf spot
tomato__septoria_leaf_spot.symptoms: Many small circular spots with dark borders and grey centres dotted with black specks, starting on lowest leaves after first fruit set.
act_now: Remove infected lower leaves.
Mancozeb or chlorothalonil at 7-day intervals in wet weather.
tomato__septoria_leaf_spot.chemical: Mancozeb 2.5 g/L; chlorothalonil 2 g/L; azoxystrobin alternating.
tomato__septoria_leaf_spot.prevent: Mulch, staking, 3-year rotation, destroy nightshade weeds.

tomato__spider_mites.name: Two-spotted spider mite
tomato__spider_mites.symptoms: Fine yellow stippling on leaves, bronzing, fine webbing on undersides, leaves dry and drop; explodes in hot dry weather.
act_now: Wash foliage with a strong water spray in the morning to knock mites off.
Spray spiromesifen or abamectin on leaf undersides; repeat after 7 days to catch hatching eggs.
Stop any pyrethroid sprays, which kill predators and cause mite flare-ups.
tomato__spider_mites.organic: Neem oil 5 ml/L + soap, release Phytoseiulus persimilis predators, sulphur dust.
tomato__spider_mites.chemical: Spiromesifen 1 ml/L, abamectin 0.5 ml/L, fenpyroximate 1 ml/L; alternate.
tomato__spider_mites.prevent: Keep plants irrigated in heat, avoid dust on leaves, conserve predatory mites.

tomato__leaf_curl_virus.name: Leaf curl virus
tomato__leaf_curl_virus.symptoms: Curled, puckered, yellowing small leaves and stunted bushy plants; little fruit set.
act_now: Remove infected plants in a bag.
Whitefly control: yellow traps, neem, then spiromesifen or diafenthiuron at threshold.
tomato__leaf_curl_virus.organic: Neem oil weekly, reflective mulch, traps.
tomato__leaf_curl_virus.chemical: Diafenthiuron 1 g/L or spiromesifen 1 ml/L; rotate.
tomato__leaf_curl_virus.prevent: Net-house nursery, resistant hybrids, barrier crops.

tomato__spotted_wilt.name: Spotted wilt virus
tomato__spotted_wilt.symptoms: Bronze or purple flecking and ring spots on young leaves, dieback of growing tip, ring patterns on fruit.
act_now: Rogue infected plants.
Control thrips: blue sticky traps, spinosad or fipronil at the nursery and after transplanting.
tomato__spotted_wilt.organic: Spinosad, neem, blue traps, reflective mulch.
tomato__spotted_wilt.prevent: Resistant (Sw-5) hybrids, weed control, thrips-free transplants.

rice__bacterial_leaf_blight.name: Bacterial leaf blight
rice__bacterial_leaf_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked yellow to white streaks starting at leaf tips and margins, wavy edges, whole leaves dry out; kresek wilt of seedlings.
act_now: Drain the field for a few days and skip nitrogen top-dressing until it slows.
Spray copper oxychloride plus streptocycline; repeat after 10 days.
rice__bacterial_leaf_blight.organic: Copper hydroxide; Pseudomonas fluorescens seed treatment; avoid excess urea.
rice__bacterial_leaf_blight.prevent: Resistant varieties (Xa21 lines), balanced nitrogen, avoid clipping seedling tips.

rice__bacterial_leaf_streak.name: Bacterial leaf streak
rice__bacterial_leaf_streak.symptoms: Narrow translucent streaks between veins that turn brown, with yellow bacterial ooze in the morning.
act_now: Reduce nitrogen; copper spray if spreading.
rice__bacterial_leaf_streak.prevent: Clean seed, resistant varieties, good drainage.

rice__bacterial_panicle_blight.name: Bacterial panicle blight
rice__bacterial_panicle_blight.symptoms: Panicles stay upright with straw-coloured empty grains, florets have a dark line at the base; worst in hot nights.
act_now: No curative spray; reduce nitrogen and avoid late top-dressing.
Harvest affected panicles separately.
rice__bacterial_panicle_blight.organic: Balanced nitrogen, earlier sowing to avoid heat at flowering.
rice__bacterial_panicle_blight.prevent: Clean seed, moderate nitrogen, heat-tolerant varieties.

rice__blast.name: Blast
rice__blast.symptoms: Diamond-shaped grey lesions with brown margins on leaves; neck blast breaks the panicle and empties grain.
act_now: Spray tricyclazole or isoprothiolane now and again at booting to protect the neck.
Hold off nitrogen; keep the field flooded rather than alternating wet and dry.
rice__blast.organic: Pseudomonas fluorescens sprays, silicon (rice husk ash), resistant varieties.
rice__blast.chemical: Tricyclazole 0.6 g/L; isoprothiolane 1.5 ml/L; azoxystrobin + tebuconazole.
rice__blast.prevent: Resistant varieties, split nitrogen, avoid dense nurseries, timely sowing.

rice__brown_spot.name: Brown spot
rice__brown_spot.symptoms: Oval brown spots with grey centres scattered over leaves; discoloured grain. Worst on poor, potassium- or silicon-deficient soil.
act_now: Correct nutrition: potash and zinc top-dress.
Mancozeb or propiconazole if more than 10% leaf area is spotted.
rice__brown_spot.organic: Balanced nutrition, seed treatment with Trichoderma.
rice__brown_spot.prevent: Seed treatment, potassium and silicon, avoid drought stress.

rice__dead_heart.name: Dead heart (stem borer)
rice__dead_heart.symptoms: Central shoot dries up and pulls out easily in the vegetative stage; white empty panicles (whiteheads) later.
act_now: Pull and destroy dead hearts; put out pheromone traps at 8 per acre.
If more than 5% dead hearts, apply cartap hydrochloride or chlorantraniliprole granules.
rice__dead_heart.organic: Trichogramma japonicum cards weekly, pheromone traps, light traps.
rice__dead_heart.prevent: Clip seedling tips before transplanting, synchronous planting, stubble destruction.

rice__downy_mildew.name: Downy mildew
rice__downy_mildew.symptoms: Pale twisted leaves, stunted tillers, malformed panicles; follows flooding of seedbeds.
act_now: Drain waterlogged nurseries; remove affected plants.
Metalaxyl seed treatment for the next nursery.
rice__downy_mildew.organic: Avoid flooded seedbeds, use raised nursery beds.

rice__hispa.name: Rice hispa
rice__hispa.symptoms: White parallel streaks scraped along the leaf by the beetle, mined patches by grubs, leaves turn whitish and dry.
act_now: Clip and destroy leaf tips carrying eggs and grubs.
Spray quinalphos or chlorpyrifos if more than 2 beetles per hill.
rice__hispa.organic: Hand collection with nets in the morning, neem oil.
rice__hispa.prevent: Avoid excess nitrogen, remove grassy weeds on bunds.

rice__healthy.name: Healthy
rice__healthy.symptoms: Erect green leaves without streaks or spots.
act_now: Scout for blast lesions weekly in humid weather; check panicle emergence for neck infection.
rice__healthy.prevent: Split nitrogen, resistant varieties, clean bunds.

rice__tungro.name: Tungro virus
rice__tungro.symptoms: Yellow-orange discolouration starting at leaf tips, stunted plants, few tillers, delayed flowering.
act_now: Rogue infected hills; control green leafhopper with imidacloprid or thiamethoxam.
Avoid staggered planting nearby.
rice__tungro.prevent: Tungro-resistant varieties, plough under stubble, synchronous sowing.

rice__leaf_scald.name: Leaf scald
rice__leaf_scald.symptoms: Zonate lesions with alternating light and dark brown bands from the leaf tip downward; leaves look scalded.
act_now: Reduce nitrogen; spray propiconazole or mancozeb if spreading.

rice__sheath_blight.name: Sheath blight
rice__sheath_blight.symptoms: Oval greenish-grey lesions with brown borders on leaf sheaths near the water line, climbing the plant; lodging.
act_now: Drain the field briefly; spray hexaconazole or validamycin aimed at the lower canopy.
Skip the next nitrogen split.
rice__sheath_blight.chemical: Hexaconazole 2 ml/L; validamycin 2.5 ml/L; azoxystrobin + difenoconazole.
rice__sheath_blight.prevent: Avoid dense planting and excess nitrogen, remove weeds and sclerotia.

wheat__yellow_rust.name: Yellow (stripe) rust
wheat__yellow_rust.symptoms: Yellow-orange pustules in stripes along the leaf veins, first in patches in cool humid weather.
act_now: Spray propiconazole or tebuconazole at first pustules; repeat after 15 days if the weather stays cool and wet.
Check neighbouring fields; rust spreads on wind.
wheat__yellow_rust.organic: No effective organic control; resistant varieties and early sowing.
wheat__yellow_rust.chemical: Propiconazole 1 ml/L; tebuconazole 1 ml/L; azoxystrobin + tebuconazole.
wheat__yellow_rust.prevent: Resistant varieties (Yr genes), avoid late sowing and excess nitrogen.

wheat__brown_rust.name: Brown (leaf) rust
wheat__brown_rust.symptoms: Scattered round orange-brown pustules on the upper leaf surface.
act_now: Spray a triazole if pustules appear before flag leaf emergence.

wheat__black_rust.name: Black (stem) rust
wheat__black_rust.symptoms: Elongated dark red-brown pustules on stems and leaf sheaths that tear the epidermis; stems break.
act_now: Spray tebuconazole or propiconazole immediately; repeat after 12-15 days.
wheat__black_rust.prevent: Sr-gene varieties, early sowing in warm regions.

wheat__septoria.name: Septoria leaf blotch
wheat__septoria.symptoms: Irregular tan blotches with black pycnidia dots, moving up from lower leaves after rain splash.
act_now: Protect the flag leaf: SDHI + azole at flag leaf emergence (T2).
Check the third leaf from the top; if it is infected at T1, do not skip the spray.
wheat__septoria.chemical: Bixafen + prothioconazole; fluxapyroxad + epoxiconazole; add folpet for resistance management.
wheat__septoria.prevent: Resistant varieties, later sowing, bury stubble.

wheat__tan_spot.name: Tan spot
wheat__tan_spot.symptoms: Tan diamond-shaped lesions with yellow halos and a dark centre, worst in wheat stubble.
act_now: Azole or strobilurin spray if lesions reach the top two leaves.
wheat__tan_spot.organic: Rotation away from wheat, stubble burial.

wheat__powdery_mildew.name: Powdery mildew
wheat__powdery_mildew.symptoms: White fluffy pustules on leaves and stems, mostly in dense lush crops.
act_now: Spray a mildewicide (metrafenone, proquinazid) or an azole if it climbs above the middle canopy.
wheat__powdery_mildew.prevent: Resistant varieties, moderate seed rate and nitrogen.

wheat__blast.name: Wheat blast
wheat__blast.symptoms: Bleached spikes above a dark infection point, empty grain, elliptical grey leaf lesions; hot humid heading.
act_now: Spray tricyclazole or a strobilurin + triazole at heading if warm wet weather is forecast.
Report suspected blast to extension services; it is quarantined in many regions.
wheat__blast.prevent: 2NS-carrying resistant varieties, seed treatment, avoid late sowing.

wheat__fusarium_head_blight.name: Fusarium head blight (scab)
wheat__fusarium_head_blight.symptoms: Premature bleaching of part or all of the spike, pink mould at the base of florets, shrivelled tombstone kernels and mycotoxin.
act_now: Spray a triazole (prothioconazole, metconazole) at early flowering if rain is forecast; strobilurins increase toxin.
Harvest early and blow out light kernels.
wheat__fusarium_head_blight.organic: Rotation away from maize, resistant varieties.
wheat__fusarium_head_blight.prevent: Avoid wheat after maize, resistant varieties, stubble management.

wheat__leaf_blight.name: Spot blotch (leaf blight)
wheat__leaf_blight.symptoms: Dark brown oval spots that merge and blight the leaf in warm humid conditions; common in eastern India.
act_now: Propiconazole spray at first spots, repeat at heading.
wheat__leaf_blight.organic: Seed treatment with Trichoderma, timely sowing.
wheat__leaf_blight.prevent: Resistant varieties, timely sowing, balanced potassium.

wheat__smut.name: Loose smut
wheat__smut.symptoms: Whole spike replaced by black powdery spores that blow away leaving a bare stalk.
act_now: Pull and bag smutted heads before spores spread; do not save seed from this field.

wheat__common_root_rot.name: Common root rot
wheat__common_root_rot.symptoms: Dark brown lesions on the subcrown internode, stunted tillers, white heads in patches.
act_now: Nothing curative in-season; note patches, rotate to a non-cereal next year.
wheat__common_root_rot.chemical: Seed treatment with difenoconazole or carboxin next season.
wheat__common_root_rot.prevent: Rotation, shallow seeding, avoid drought stress.

wheat__aphid.name: Aphids
wheat__aphid.symptoms: Colonies on ears and flag leaves, honeydew and sooty mould, virus transmission (BYDV) in autumn.
act_now: Spray only above threshold (5 per ear at flowering); pirimicarb spares ladybirds.
wheat__aphid.chemical: Pirimicarb; flonicamid; avoid pyrethroids where resistant.
wheat__aphid.prevent: Later autumn sowing, seed treatment where BYDV risk is high.

wheat__mite.name: Mites
wheat__mite.symptoms: Silvering or bronzing of leaves, curled leaf edges; wheat curl mite spreads streak mosaic virus.
act_now: Irrigate if drought-stressed; miticide only if bronzing spreads.
wheat__mite.prevent: Control volunteer wheat (green bridge), avoid dust.

wheat__stem_fly.name: Stem fly
wheat__stem_fly.symptoms: Dead central shoot in seedlings, larvae tunnel in the stem.
act_now: Seed treatment next time; in-season spray only in seedling stage if more than 10% dead hearts.
wheat__stem_fly.chemical: Imidacloprid seed treatment; chlorpyrifos spray at seedling stage.

wheat__healthy.name: Healthy
wheat__healthy.symptoms: Clean green leaves, no pustules or blotches.
act_now: Scout the lower canopy at tillering and the flag leaf at emergence; rusts and septoria start low.
wheat__healthy.prevent: Resistant varieties, T1/T2 fungicide timing in wet seasons.

sugarcane__mosaic.name: Mosaic virus
sugarcane__mosaic.symptoms: Light and dark green mottling along young leaves, stunted cane.
act_now: Rogue infected clumps; use disease-free setts for the next planting.
sugarcane__mosaic.organic: Hot-water treated setts; aphid control with neem.

sugarcane__yellow_leaf.name: Yellow leaf disease
sugarcane__yellow_leaf.symptoms: Bright yellow midrib on the underside of leaves 3-6, spreading into the blade; stunting.
act_now: Do not use this field for seed cane; plan a ratoon-free replant with healthy setts.

sugarcane__red_rot.name: Red rot
sugarcane__red_rot.symptoms: Drying of the third and fourth leaves, split cane shows red internal tissue with white cross-bars and a sour smell.
act_now: Remove and burn affected clumps; drain the field.
Spray carbendazim on surrounding cane; do not ratoon this field.
sugarcane__red_rot.organic: Trichoderma-treated setts, hot water treatment at 50 C for 2 h.
sugarcane__red_rot.chemical: Carbendazim 1 g/L sett dip and spray.
sugarcane__red_rot.prevent: Resistant varieties, disease-free setts, drainage, rotation.

sugarcane__rust.name: Rust
sugarcane__rust.symptoms: Elongated orange-brown pustules on leaves that erupt through the lower surface.
act_now: Spray propiconazole or mancozeb if young cane is heavily infected.

sugarcane__banded_chlorosis.name: Banded chlorosis
sugarcane__banded_chlorosis.symptoms: Transverse yellow-white bands across leaves, all at the same height, after a cold night or spray.
act_now: No treatment needed; new growth will be normal. Check herbicide timing and rates.
sugarcane__banded_chlorosis.prevent: Avoid spraying in cold snaps, correct herbicide use.

sugarcane__brown_spot.name: Brown spot
sugarcane__brown_spot.symptoms: Oval red-brown spots with yellow halos on older leaves.
act_now: Mancozeb spray if the upper canopy is affected; improve potassium.

sugarcane__grassy_shoot.name: Grassy shoot
sugarcane__grassy_shoot.symptoms: Many thin, pale, grass-like tillers with no millable cane.
act_now: Uproot and burn affected clumps; control leafhoppers.
sugarcane__grassy_shoot.organic: Hot-water sett treatment 50 C for 2 h.
sugarcane__grassy_shoot.prevent: Disease-free setts, avoid ratooning infected fields.

sugarcane__pokkah_boeng.name: Pokkah boeng
sugarcane__pokkah_boeng.symptoms: Twisted, wrinkled young leaves with chlorosis at the base, ladder-like cuts on the stalk in severe cases.
act_now: Spray carbendazim or copper on the spindle; improve drainage.

sugarcane__sett_rot.name: Sett rot
sugarcane__sett_rot.symptoms: Poor germination, setts smell of pineapple and turn red-black inside.
act_now: Gap-fill with treated setts; avoid waterlogging.
sugarcane__sett_rot.chemical: Carbendazim 1 g/L sett dip for 10 min.
sugarcane__sett_rot.prevent: Fresh setts, fungicide dip, good drainage.

sugarcane__smut.name: Smut
sugarcane__smut.symptoms: Long black whip-like structure from the growing point, thin grassy stalks.
act_now: Cut and bag whips before they open; uproot affected clumps.

sugarcane__healthy.name: Healthy
sugarcane__healthy.symptoms: Green leaves, no mottling, rust or drying.
act_now: Inspect the third and fourth leaves monthly for early red rot signs.
sugarcane__healthy.prevent: Clean seed cane, drainage, trash mulching.

brinjal__cercospora_leaf_spot.name: Cercospora leaf spot
brinjal__cercospora_leaf_spot.symptoms: Angular brown spots with grey centres on leaves; leaves yellow and drop.
act_now: Remove spotted leaves; spray mancozeb or carbendazim.

brinjal__leaf_curl_virus.name: Leaf curl (begomovirus)
brinjal__leaf_curl_virus.symptoms: Curled thickened leaves, short internodes, stunted bushy plants with little fruit.
act_now: Uproot infected plants; whitefly control with yellow traps, neem, then diafenthiuron.
brinjal__leaf_curl_virus.prevent: Net-house nursery, tolerant varieties, barrier crops.

brinjal__verticillium_wilt.name: Verticillium wilt
brinjal__verticillium_wilt.symptoms: One-sided yellowing and wilting, brown streaks inside the stem, plants collapse in warm weather.
act_now: Remove wilted plants; drench with carbendazim; do not replant solanaceous crops here.
brinjal__verticillium_wilt.organic: Soil solarisation, Trichoderma, grafting on resistant rootstock.

brinjal__healthy.name: Healthy
brinjal__healthy.symptoms: Broad green leaves without curling or spots.
act_now: Check for shoot and fruit borer entry holes twice a week.

cucumber__downy_mildew.name: Downy mildew
cucumber__downy_mildew.symptoms: Angular yellow patches bounded by veins on the upper surface, grey-purple fuzz beneath in the morning.
act_now: Spray a systemic (cymoxanil + mancozeb, dimethomorph) today; improve airflow.
cucumber__downy_mildew.organic: Copper hydroxide protectant; morning irrigation only.
cucumber__downy_mildew.prevent: Resistant varieties, drip irrigation, wide spacing.

cucumber__anthracnose.name: Anthracnose
cucumber__anthracnose.symptoms: Round brown spots that crack in the centre on leaves; sunken lesions on fruit.
act_now: Mancozeb or azoxystrobin spray; remove infected debris.
cucumber__anthracnose.prevent: Clean seed, rotation, avoid overhead irrigation.

cucumber__healthy.name: Healthy
cucumber__healthy.symptoms: Green leaves without angular spots or powder.
act_now: Scout for downy mildew in cool wet spells.

bitter_gourd__downy_mildew.name: Downy mildew
bitter_gourd__downy_mildew.symptoms: Yellow angular patches, grey fuzz on the underside, rapid leaf death.
act_now: Systemic + contact fungicide now; improve airflow on the trellis.

bitter_gourd__mosaic_virus.name: Mosaic virus
bitter_gourd__mosaic_virus.symptoms: Mottled, blistered, distorted leaves and deformed fruit.
act_now: Remove infected vines; control aphids with neem or imidacloprid.
bitter_gourd__mosaic_virus.prevent: Barrier crops, early aphid control, resistant varieties.

bitter_gourd__fusarium_wilt.name: Fusarium wilt
bitter_gourd__fusarium_wilt.symptoms: Vines yellow and wilt from the base upward in the heat of the day, brown vascular streaks in the stem.
act_now: Remove wilted vines; drench remaining plants with carbendazim; do not replant cucurbits here for 3 years.
bitter_gourd__fusarium_wilt.organic: Trichoderma with farmyard manure, grafting on resistant rootstock.

bitter_gourd__healthy.name: Healthy
bitter_gourd__healthy.symptoms: Deeply lobed green leaves without mottling.
act_now: Check for fruit fly and aphids weekly.

bottle_gourd__downy_mildew.name: Downy mildew
bottle_gourd__downy_mildew.symptoms: Yellow angular patches with grey fuzz beneath.
act_now: Systemic fungicide now; trellis for airflow.

bottle_gourd__anthracnose.name: Anthracnose
bottle_gourd__anthracnose.symptoms: Brown cracked spots on leaves, sunken fruit lesions.
act_now: Mancozeb spray; remove infected debris.

bottle_gourd__healthy.name: Healthy
act_now: Scout for red pumpkin beetle at seedling stage.

cauliflower__black_rot.name: Black rot
cauliflower__black_rot.symptoms: V-shaped yellow lesions from the leaf margin with black veins; heads rot.
act_now: Remove infected plants; copper + streptocycline spray.

cauliflower__downy_mildew.name: Downy mildew
cauliflower__downy_mildew.symptoms: Yellow patches with white fuzz on the underside; black speckling on curds.
act_now: Metalaxyl + mancozeb spray; thin the nursery.

cauliflower__healthy.name: Healthy
act_now: Scout for diamondback moth larvae under leaves.
cauliflower__healthy.prevent: Bt sprays, trap crops, clean seed.

other.name: Not a crop leaf
other.symptoms: The photo is not a leaf of a crop the scanner knows.
act_now: Photograph a single leaf filling the frame in daylight against a plain background.
